UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private Google account profile for an authenticated TileTown player.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

displayName.description: Player display name from Google profile.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

CitySaveState.title: CitySaveState
CitySaveState.description: Persistent cloud save containing city plots, resources, Match-3 board, and stats.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the save owner.

civicPop.description: Bonus citizen population earned from Match-3 civic matches.

turnsPlayed.description: Total turns played in the current city.

bestPopulation.description: All-time highest population achieved across sessions.

prestigeLevel.description: Permanent Prestige tier earned by ascending a qualifying city.

lots.description: Fixed 225-element array representing the 15x15 city plots.

boardCells.description: Fixed 225-element flattened array representing the 15x15 Match-3 tiles.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud save was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest cloud save.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores private Google account profile metadata owned strictly by userId.

/users/{userId}/gameState/{saveId}.description: Stores persistent city and Match-3 cloud save documents owned strictly by userId.
